name: Verified Procedural Memory Promotion
mechanism: Promotes a reusable workflow only after repeated successful traces are generalized into explicit preconditions, steps, postconditions and rollback instructions.
use_when: Tasks recur with stable interfaces and objective verification
A successful procedure can be replayed safely in a sandbox
avoid_when: A single success is the only supporting evidence
The environment or permissions differ across future executions
expected_effects: Reduced rediscovery cost for recurring tasks
Auditable reusable procedures with applicability bounds
failure_modes: Overgeneralized procedure runs outside its preconditions
Stored steps reference stale tools or schemas
A successful but unsafe trace is promoted
